superAdmin.title: Platform Overview
superAdmin.subtitle: Business client distribution. Platform health metrics are not wired up yet.
superAdmin.emptyDescription: Organizations that sign up will be listed here.
superAdmin.createTenantIntro: Creates the workspace and its first Business Owner together. The owner signs in with the email and password you set here.
superAdmin.fieldUrlSlugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. This becomes the workspace's web address and cannot be changed later.
superAdmin.fieldOwnerEmailHelp: The Business Owner who will run this workspace.
superAdmin.fieldOwnerPasswordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit. Share it with the owner securely.
superAdmin.errSlugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
superAdmin.errPasswordRules: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
superAdmin.confirmSuspendMessage: Everyone at {{name}} will be signed out and blocked from signing in. Nothing is deleted — all their data is kept, and you can reactivate the workspace at any time.
superAdmin.confirmReactivateMessage: {{name}} will be able to sign in again immediately, with all their data as they left it.
superAdmin.confirmDeleteMessage: This permanently deletes {{name}} — every client, quotation, product, appointment, user and uploaded file. This cannot be undone.
superAdmin.confirmDeleteMismatch: That doesn't match the workspace slug.
superAdmin.peopleEmptyDescription: Try clearing the filters, or create an account.
superAdmin.closeAccountSubtitle: Permanently close your own platform administrator account. This cannot be undone.
superAdmin.closeAccountLastAdmin: You are the only platform administrator. Appoint another one before closing your account.
superAdmin.closeAccountWarning: Your account will be closed permanently and you will be signed out immediately. This cannot be undone.
superAdmin.platformSettingsSubtitle: Platform-wide defaults for new workspaces, or apply changes directly to workspaces you choose.
superAdmin.scopeSubtitle: Pick a scope before editing the fields below — it decides what Save actually does.
superAdmin.scopePlatformHint: Sets the starting values for workspaces created from now on. Existing workspaces are never affected.
superAdmin.scopeTenantsHint: Applies immediately to the workspaces you choose below — the same as each one's own admin making the change.
superAdmin.applyingToPlatform: Applying to: Platform default (future workspaces only)
superAdmin.confirmPlatformMessage: This changes the starting values for workspaces created from now on. No existing workspace is affected.
superAdmin.confirmTenantsMessage_one: This immediately changes settings for 1 workspace:
superAdmin.confirmTenantsMessage_other: This immediately changes settings for {{count}} workspaces:
superAdmin.confirmSuspendUserMessage: {{name}} will be signed out and blocked from signing in. Nothing is deleted — you can reactivate them at any time.
superAdmin.confirmReactivateUserMessage: {{name}} will be able to sign in again immediately.
superAdmin.confirmDeleteUserMessage: This permanently deletes {{name}}'s account. Their name, email and phone are removed; their history (quotations, appointments, activity) is kept for the workspace's records. This cannot be undone.
superAdmin.confirmDeleteUserMismatch: That doesn't match the user's email.
superAdmin.ownershipTransferHelpSuspend: This person is the Business Owner and has active staff. Choose one to temporarily take over while they're suspended — you'll be able to restore or keep this when reactivating.
superAdmin.ownershipTransferHelpDelete: This person is the Business Owner and has active staff. Choose one to permanently take over the workspace before deleting them.
superAdmin.selectOwnerRequired: Choose a new Business Owner to continue.
superAdmin.ownershipRestoreChoiceIntro: {{name}} has been standing in as Business Owner while the original owner was suspended. Choose what happens now:
superAdmin.restoreOriginalOwnershipDescription: This user becomes Business Owner again, and the standing-in staff member returns to their previous role.
superAdmin.keepCurrentOwnershipDescription: The standing-in staff member stays Business Owner, and this user rejoins as a regular staff member.
superAdmin.keepBothOwnersDescription: This user becomes Business Owner again and the standing-in member keeps the role too. The workspace ends up with two owners and nobody is demoted.
superAdmin.inviteUserIntro: They'll get an email link and choose their own password. Inviting a Business Owner adds one — a workspace can have several, and no existing owner is replaced.
superAdmin.inviteUserIntroPlatformAdmin: They'll get an email link and choose their own password. Platform Admins belong to no workspace and can administer every one of them.
superAdmin.inviteRoleHelp: Business Owners administer the workspace alongside any existing owners. Staff work inside it.
superAdmin.inviteRoleHelpPlatformAdmin: Platform Admins can administer every workspace on the platform.
